blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Talia Gibson – Pan Pacific Open Round of 16 TOKYO–Alex Eala came from behind to beat Talia Gibson 4-6, 6-2, 6-0 at the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo on Wednesday and said “it took a lot to turn that match around”. The world number 19’s recent run of early tournament exits looked in danger of continuing when Australia’s Gibson, ranked 38, took the first set at the Pan Pacific Open. But Eala dug in and evened the match before hitting top gear in a dominating third set. READ: Alex Eala into Pan Pacific Open quarterfinals, beats Talia […]...
